narrative.overview: This app extends the established desktop identity through native Material 3 controls. Ink navy, cool text, cyan audio data and amber actions become semantic color roles with a separate light scheme. The task is importing an existing WAV, reviewing cuts and exporting FLAC; recording remains deferred.
keyCharacteristics: Source identity stays near audio review.
Text labels explain actions and selected states.
Real waveform data supplies the signature visual.

rules.name: The Semantic Role Rule
rules.body: Resolve component colors through `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` so both schemes retain their role pairings.

dos: Do retain labeled native controls and the accessible slider alternative to waveform tapping.
Do keep source identity, explicit synthetic labels and export validation visible in the task hierarchy.
Do preserve the original icon: `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/puredub.png` is an unchanged copy of root `assets/puredub.png`; root `assets/ICON.md` records its MIT provenance.
donts: Don't treat suggested cuts or metadata as proven boundaries.
Don't replace the data-driven Canvas with decorative waveform imagery. No generated raster asset or Android image composition exists.
Don't claim tablet, emulator or whole-platform certification from the phone review.
